name: Bakery Pastry Shop
place: An artisan bakery smelling of fresh bread
speaker: Baker

tasks.goal: Greet the baker and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the baker and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about freshly baked sourdough bread loaves
tasks.hint: Ask what bread came out of the oven today.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fresh sourdough bread availability.

tasks.goal: Ask for gluten-free or dairy-free pastry selections
tasks.hint: Inquire about special dietary bakery options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about gluten-free or dairy-free pastries.

tasks.goal: Request half a dozen almond croissants and a baguette

tasks.goal: Ask about ingredients used in signature fruit tart

tasks.goal: Use the word 'patisserie'
tasks.hint: Patisserie refers to fine French pastries or pastry shop. Comment on the patisserie selection.

tasks.goal: Inquire how to properly store artisanal bread to keep it fresh
tasks.hint: Ask baker for bread preservation advice.

tasks.hint: Inquire about daily baking schedule.

tasks.goal: Politely report receiving wrong pastry in takeaway box

tasks.goal: Ask if bulk discounts apply to catering muffin platters
tasks.hint: Inquire about large order event pricing.

tasks.goal: Confirm payment total and box packaging care

tasks.goal: Request a paper receipt showing detailed pastry prices
tasks.hint: Ask for receipt listing individual item prices.

tasks.goal: Ask if espresso coffee drinks are served to go

tasks.goal: Inquire about morning baked specialty items available today

tasks.goal: Express fondness for traditional butter croissants and fruit tarts

tasks.goal: Ask baker how early baking operations begin each morning
tasks.hint: Inquire about kitchen start times and dough preparation.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about morning baking schedule.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'assortment'

tasks.goal: Use the word 'glaze'
